config_dir.description: Directory containing the system-wide rlprrc file

printer.description: Default printer queue name, optionally followed by @hostname

printhost.description: Default host to print to (used if not in printer variable)

proxyhost.description: Host to use as an rlprd proxy for privileged port access

copies.description: Default number of copies to print

tmpdir.description: Directory to store temporary job files

timeout.description: Connection inactivity timeout in seconds (-1 for forever)

user.description: Username to display on burst pages

job.description: Job name to display on burst pages

title.description: Title string to display in pr(1) headers

class.description: Class name to display on burst pages

extargs.description: Arguments specific to the OS extension mode
